def process(mmc1) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = mmc1.copy()

    # Coerce Age to numeric; keep only patients strictly above 70
    df['Age_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Age'], errors='coerce')
    older = df[df['Age_num'] > 70].copy()

    # Count FIGO_stage occurrences (ignore missing)
    counts = (
        older['FIGO_stage']
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .replace({'': pd.NA})
        .dropna()
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis('FIGO_stage')
        .reset_index(name='n')
    )

    if counts.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame([{'FIGO_stage_mode': pd.NA, 'n': 0, 'n_samples_age_gt_70': int(len(older))}])

    top = counts.iloc[0]
    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            'FIGO_stage_mode': top['FIGO_stage'],
            'n': int(top['n']),
            'n_samples_age_gt_70': int(len(older)),
        }
    ])
